component.name: PKG Explorer
component.summary: Browse PS4 .pkg files and extract only what you need
Navegue por arquivos .pkg de PS4 e extraia só o que quiser

description.p: PKG Explorer opens PS4 package files (.pkg) like an archive: see the files and folders inside without extracting everything, then extract only the ones you want.

ul.li: Opens packages of tens of gigabytes in under a second
Shows the game icon, title, Title ID, type (game, update or DLC) and version
Extract selected files and folders, or the whole package using the shadPS4 folder layout
Install a game, update or DLC straight into the right shadPS4 folder
Check the package integrity to detect damaged downloads
Drag files out to your file manager; on KDE Plasma they are extracted straight to where you drop them

description.p: Supports the same packages as the shadPS4 extractor (fake/fpkg packages).

ul.li: Install in shadPS4: puts a game, update or DLC in the right shadPS4 folder, read from shadPS4's own settings
Integrity check: a quick check when a package is opened, and a full check in the menu that detects damaged downloads
Fixed random crashes during extraction (present since 1.0)
Closing the window during an extraction now cancels it cleanly
Only one extraction runs at a time; no memory left behind after each extraction
Faster progress updates on very large packages
Malicious PKGs can no longer write files outside the destination folder
Malformed PKGs are rejected with a clear message instead of crashing the app
Release files come with SHA256 checksums
